explanation: erdosproblems.com/448: Hall and Tenenbaum [HaTe88, §4.6] showed the upper density of {n : τ⁺(n) < ε τ(n)} is ≪ ε log(2/ε). The Lean statement is the corresponding big-O as ε → 0⁺ of the upper density against ε log(2/ε). Since ε is small the asymptotic form captures the result. Faithful.
